newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends mixed, rallies late as shorts cover.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends mixed, rallies late as shorts cover.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed but mostly higher with the market rallying late on short covering, traders said.
"It was a late pre-report short covering rally," a trader said. "But there was plenty of selling around" which limited the gains.
USDA at 0730 CST/1330 GMT Tuesday will release its November crop production report and supply/demand reports.
"With the report coming out tomorrow the cash markets were quiet," the trader said.
Rice closed two cents per cwt lower to six higher with November down two at $10.12 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 100 contracts, below the 350 contracts traded Friday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at five contracts, below the 12 contracts Friday.
